content.text:
=== scenario ===
include:
  - ../services/data_store_backend/service.yml
=== full service.yml ===
services:$
  data_store_backend:$
    build:$
      context: ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend$
      args:$
        INDEX_URL: ${PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL:-}$
    command: sh scripts/start-server.sh$
    volumes:$
      - ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend:/app$
      - ../../../../../../apps/data_store_backend/data_store:/data_store$
    container_name: data-store-backend-service$
    ports:$
      - 8007:8000$
    environment:$
      - API__ENVIRONMENT=COMPOSE_ALL=== depends_on / includes in service? ===

observation.command: cd /workspace/deployment/runtimes/compose/dev && echo "=== scenario ==="; cat scenarios/debug-data_store_backend.yml; echo "=== full service.yml ==="; cat -A services/data_store_backend/service.yml; echo "=== depends_on / includes in service? ==="; grep -rn "depends_on\|include\|postgres\|kafka\|mqtt" services/data_store_backend/ 2>/dev/null
